Name: CatNaps in Stardew
Author: WarMaster912
Description:
****Credits****

Artist - @ChrisPixelArt

Programmer - @samhead2001

****Changes****

[list]
[*]Exchanged all of Leah's Sprites and Portraits to CatNaps
[*]Replaced all "Leah"s in dialogue with "Catto"
[*]Replaced "Leah Portrait" with "Catto Portrait"
[*]Replaced "Leah's Sculpture" with "Catto's Sculpture"
[*]Added special voice lines when conditions are met
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added Catto's hairstyle to character customization, for correct colors set the values to (0,0,99)
[/list]
****Voice Line Conditions****

[list]
[*]Must be married to Catto
[*]Give gift to Catto when they are located inside the FarmHouse or outside on the Farm
[/list]

Manifest.Name: (CP) CatNaps replaces Leah
Manifest.Description: This mod changes the appearance of Leah to the VTuber CatNaps.
Manifest.Author: Programmer: samhead, Artist: @ChrisPixelArt on Twitter, Bug Tester: MrsDinoMunster
